title: Nestor's Breakable Bedrock
description: Adds a somewhat balanced way to break bedrock, also adds other things
body:
Have you ever wanted to break bedrock? Sure you have, how else are you gonna fall into the void and end your Hardcore run for the funny? Better yet, did you want to add the Create: Aeronautics End Sea into the overworld and nether and need a way to get down there?
Well with the power of echo shards, you can! 

Simply craft an Echo bomb using TNT, Echo shards, and Sculk, and you can turn all the bedrock within a small area into Shattered Bedrock which can simply be mined with a run of the mill pickaxe... eventually. 
even being shattered, it still has the hardness of obsidian. What, did you think it'd be easy? Get real!
Now, I know what you're saying... "But Mr. Nestor, what if i want to break bedrock in a larger radius?"
WELL I'M GLAD YOU ASKED! That's what the Echo Breaker is for!

Simply input 4 redstone dust or one redstone block to charge it, then power it with a button or lever and wait a few seconds! Why so long? Because I was gonna make the echo breaker's "sonic explosion" do damage just like the echo bomb, but couldn't get it to work, and I didn't feel like trying to use commands.
Maybe next update. Anyways, the echo breaker breaks a lot more bedrock.

But don't dilly or dally, my minecraftian compadres, because shattered bedrock slowly turns back into regular unbreakable bedrock! Eventually. I haven't tested it, but it compiled, so it probably works. (and it does, score!)

Also, the mod adds a few decorative counterfeit bedrock blocksets, as well as some real bedrock versions for the admins. Also, a sword.
The main thing is the breaking of the bedrock, I'm already bored of typing the description out, just try the mod for yourself, comment if there are bugs or for the heck of it, I'm gonna go take a nap.
I didn't even write this by hand, I just copy-pasted it from curseforge.

-sincerely, "Pseudonym: Nestor Trigg", MFNminerdz
